card.name: Start of a new section or sentence
card.fires_on: Responds to the first word or gap right after a number, heading or section break, where a new clause begins. Often it sits just before a repeated heading word or between a number and its unit.

modes.label: Gap after a number
modes.description: A space or break between a dose number and the next number or unit.

modes.label: Word right after a section number
modes.description: The first piece of a heading word or new sentence after a section number or a period.

modes.label: New sentence after a dose phrase
modes.description: A sentence-opening word such as If, some or He after a dose or time phrase.
